headline: Coromandel International reports a 24.59% drop in quarterly profit
summary: Coromandel International has posted a 24.59 percent decline in its profit for the latest reporting period. The drop reflects headwinds in the agribusiness sector, impacting the fertilizer and specialty nutrient maker's bottom line. Retail investors tracking agricultural inputs and rural demand will note the margin contraction. The earnings decline could weigh on near-term sentiment for the company's shares listed on Indian exchanges.
why_it_matters: Near-term pressure on Coromandel International shares
